title: Aeroradioactivity map of Charleston and vicinity, South Carolina
citation: Coastal Plains Regional Commission, and U.S. Geological Survey, 1976, Aeroradioactivity map of Charleston and vicinity, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-76-30, map scale 1:250,000.
notes:
Single OCR sheet: aeroradioactivity (gamma-ray) map at 1:250,000, not a geologic map; it has no geologic units, borings, structures or aquifer data. Survey parameters printed (page 1), which the schema cannot hold: contour interval 25.0 counts; flight altitude 500 feet AGL; flight line spacing 1.0 mile; instrumentation Exploranium model DiSA 400 A gamma ray spectrometer; flown and compiled 1976; data altitude corrected only. Index of 27 1:62,500 aeroradioactivity maps (Bowman ... James Island) available from the state Division of Geology. Map face is noise.
SUBSURFACE: none; the sheet has no cross section, structure contours, logs or vertical datum (page 1).
